fixes.explanation: True, baker! "After Moses had sent spies to Jazer, Israel captured its villages and drove out the Amorites who were there." (Numbers 21:32) Scouts first, then the move. That's like checking the oven before you slide the tray in, because nobody wants to find out the hard way. The verse gives us that order.

Right on the money, baker. Og and his whole army come out to meet Israel in battle at Edrei (Numbers 21:33). That's a whole army marching at them, and I think that's a moment to feel pretty small. Then the LORD says to Moses, "Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand…" (Numbers 21:34) He also tells Moses to do to Og what he did to Sihon.

problems.problem: It has 6 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.
“Israel looked before it took the villages” presents the spies’ reconnaissance as accomplished. The text says Moses sent spies, but does not say what they saw or reported.
“The LORD speaks before a single sword swings” asserts a detail about the timing of the fighting that the text does not give.
